## Validation

List commands run and results. For device checks, name the model, Android version and app starting state. State what was not checked.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope is one problem; existing helpers and patterns reused where possible.
- [ ] Changed behavior is covered by a focused test or a documented manual check.
- [ ] SYSTEM.md updated with behavior/architecture changes, or no such change.
- [ ] Approval content and commit-gate checks preserved; model cannot approve actions.
- [ ] Device values read at runtime; no personal data or credentials included.
